title: DisplayServer get size, dpi, scale on Multiple monitor build is taken and propaging from primary monitor.
body:
### Tested versions

Godot version is v4.4.1.stable.official [49a5bc7b6] 




### System information

Windows 11 pro, version 24H2 compilacion 26100.4946 -  AMD Ryzen 7 5800X3D 8-Core Processor - Graphic Card : AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX

### Issue description

When the functions screen_get size, dpi, scale from DisplayServer are called on a Build with multiples displays/monitors the information from DisplayServer is wrong.

Display/monitors distribution:
primary ( 0 )
2560x1440 scale 125%

secondary (1)
1920x1080 scale 100%

secondary (2)
4096x2160 scale 200%

I call this functions from DisplayServer for assign resolution on viewport.

DisplayServer.screen_get_size( screen )
DisplayServer.screen_get_dpi( screen  )
DisplayServer.screen_get_scale( screen  )

When i print the values from my displays i got the below data:

Screen 0 (Primary monitor):
size: (2560, 1440)             #  Correct Value
DPI:120                            #  Correct Value
SCALE:1.0                         #  Incorrect Value it must be 1.25

Screen 1:
size: (2400, 1350)            #  Incorrect Value the correct is 1920x1080
DPI:120                            #  Incorrect Value the correct must be 96
SCALE:1.0                         #  Correct Value 

Screen 2
size: (2560, 1350)            #  Incorrect Value the correct is 4096x2160
DPI:120                            #  Incorrect Value the correct must be 192
SCALE:1.0                         #  Incorrect Value the scale is 2.0

Also if primary monitor is changed in Windows settings by Screen 2 and print the values again the DPI change in all the outputs by 192 DPI like DPI is taken from primary screen and cloned in all the screens.


### Steps to reproduce

At least two monitors, and change windows scale on primary monitor.
example primary 125% scale and secondary 100% scale.

then get DisplayServer info and print it:
DisplayServer.screen_get_size( screen )
DisplayServer.screen_get_dpi( screen  )
DisplayServer.screen_get_scale( screen  )

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)
```
func _on_test_display_server() -> void:
	
	print_rich( "[bgcolor=white][color=black]", "TEST DISPLAY SERVER (SIZE, POSITION, SCALE, etc) "  ,"[/color][/bgcolor]" )
	print("Primary Screen is:", DisplayServer.get_primary_screen())
	for display in DisplayServer.get_screen_count() :
		print_rich( "[color=green]", "Screen ", display, " : SIZE : ", DisplayServer.screen_get_size(display) ,"[/color]" )
		print("DPI:", DisplayServer.screen_get_dpi(display))
		print("SCALE:", DisplayServer.screen_get_scale(display))
		print("POSITION:", DisplayServer.screen_get_position(display), "\n")

```
